name: Builtin Cluster: Cross-Sectional group_by Variants
description: Tests: cs_agg, cs_first_last, cs_momentum, cs_quantile, cs_select, cs_weighted_mean, cs_zscore with group_by=asset_class/auto_detect/base_currency/category/exchange/industry/quote_currency/sector. Multi-equity universe with sector/industry classification metadata.
source:
# =============================================================================
# BUILTIN CLUSTER: Cross-Sectional group_by Variants
# =============================================================================
# Uses 8 stocks spanning 4 sectors (Tech, Financials, Energy, Consumer)
# to test all AssetGroupingMode variants.

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
volume = src.v

ret = returns(close)
ret_21 = returns(period=21)(close)
factor = sma(close, 50)

# === CS_AGG: 8 group_by variants (type already covered in cs_variants) ===
agg_ac = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.Mean, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.asset_class)(ret)
agg_ad = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.Mean, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.auto_detect)(ret)
agg_bc = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.Mean, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.base_currency)(ret)
agg_cat = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.Mean, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.category)(ret)
agg_ex = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.Mean, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.exchange)(ret)
agg_ind = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.Mean, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.industry)(ret)
agg_qc = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.Mean, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.quote_currency)(ret)
agg_sec = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.Mean, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.sector)(ret)

# === CS_ZSCORE: 8 group_by variants ===
zs_ac = cs_zscore(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.asset_class)(ret_21)
zs_ad = cs_zscore(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.auto_detect)(ret_21)
zs_bc = cs_zscore(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.base_currency)(ret_21)
zs_cat = cs_zscore(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.category)(ret_21)
zs_ex = cs_zscore(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.exchange)(ret_21)
zs_ind = cs_zscore(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.industry)(ret_21)
zs_qc = cs_zscore(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.quote_currency)(ret_21)
zs_sec = cs_zscore(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.sector)(ret_21)

# === CS_QUANTILE: 8 group_by variants ===
cq_ac = cs_quantile(q=0.5, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.asset_class)(ret_21)
cq_ad = cs_quantile(q=0.5, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.auto_detect)(ret_21)
cq_bc = cs_quantile(q=0.5, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.base_currency)(ret_21)
cq_cat = cs_quantile(q=0.5, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.category)(ret_21)
cq_ex = cs_quantile(q=0.5, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.exchange)(ret_21)
cq_ind = cs_quantile(q=0.5, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.industry)(ret_21)
cq_qc = cs_quantile(q=0.5, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.quote_currency)(ret_21)
cq_sec = cs_quantile(q=0.5, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.sector)(ret_21)

# === CS_SELECT: 8 group_by variants ===
sel_ac = cs_select(direction=CSSelectDirection.top, k=2, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.asset_class)(ret_21)
sel_ad = cs_select(direction=CSSelectDirection.top, k=2, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.auto_detect)(ret_21)
sel_bc = cs_select(direction=CSSelectDirection.top, k=2, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.base_currency)(ret_21)
sel_cat = cs_select(direction=CSSelectDirection.top, k=2, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.category)(ret_21)
sel_ex = cs_select(direction=CSSelectDirection.top, k=2, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.exchange)(ret_21)
sel_ind = cs_select(direction=CSSelectDirection.top, k=2, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.industry)(ret_21)
sel_qc = cs_select(direction=CSSelectDirection.top, k=2, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.quote_currency)(ret_21)
sel_sec = cs_select(direction=CSSelectDirection.top, k=2, group_by=AssetGroupingMode.sector)(ret_21)

# === CS_WEIGHTED_MEAN: 8 group_by variants ===
wm_ac = cs_weighted_mean(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.asset_class)(ret_21, volume)
wm_ad = cs_weighted_mean(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.auto_detect)(ret_21, volume)
wm_bc = cs_weighted_mean(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.base_currency)(ret_21, volume)
wm_cat = cs_weighted_mean(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.category)(ret_21, volume)
wm_ex = cs_weighted_mean(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.exchange)(ret_21, volume)
wm_ind = cs_weighted_mean(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.industry)(ret_21, volume)
wm_qc = cs_weighted_mean(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.quote_currency)(ret_21, volume)
wm_sec = cs_weighted_mean(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.sector)(ret_21, volume)

# === CS_FIRST_LAST: 8 group_by variants ===
fl_ac = cs_first_last(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.asset_class)(ret)
fl_ad = cs_first_last(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.auto_detect)(ret)
fl_bc = cs_first_last(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.base_currency)(ret)
fl_cat = cs_first_last(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.category)(ret)
fl_ex = cs_first_last(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.exchange)(ret)
fl_ind = cs_first_last(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.industry)(ret)
fl_qc = cs_first_last(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.quote_currency)(ret)
fl_sec = cs_first_last(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.sector)(ret)

# === CS_MOMENTUM: 8 group_by variants ===
mom_ac = cs_momentum(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.asset_class)(ret)
mom_ad = cs_momentum(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.auto_detect)(ret)
mom_bc = cs_momentum(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.base_currency)(ret)
mom_cat = cs_momentum(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.category)(ret)
mom_ex = cs_momentum(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.exchange)(ret)
mom_ind = cs_momentum(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.industry)(ret)
mom_qc = cs_momentum(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.quote_currency)(ret)
mom_sec = cs_momentum(group_by=AssetGroupingMode.sector)(ret)

# === REPORTERS ===
cs_lines(
    title='CS Agg Mean Return by Sector',
    category='CS GroupBy'
)(x_values=index(), y_values=agg_sec)

cs_lines(
    title='CS ZScore by Industry',
    category='CS GroupBy'
)(x_values=index(), y_values=zs_ind)

cs_lines(
    title='CS Momentum by Sector',
    category='CS GroupBy'
)(x_values=index(), y_values=mom_sec)
